scan_table_check.description:
Flags in-progress update sets that capture a change (not a delete) to a record that is also captured in another in-progress update set. Two developers are changing the same artifact; whichever update set is committed last silently overwrites the other. The finding is recorded against the update set and lists each shared artifact and the other update sets.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: Artifact Modified in Multiple In-Progress Update Sets".
scan_table_check.name: SN-CFG-005: Artifact also changed in another in-progress update set
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Coordinate with the owner of the other update set: merge the work into one update set, or complete and promote them in a deliberate order. Otherwise whichever is committed last silently overwrites the other.
scan_table_check.short_description: A record in this update set is also in another in-progress update set.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-CFG-005: Artifact also changed in another in-progress update set
